title: Formula for scalar extension of the comparison-origin coefficient unit
statement: For a unital commutative-ring map φ:A→B and scheme T, finiteGeneralRingScalarUnitIso(φ,T).hom is pbcComparisonReduction at the ordinary A coefficient unit followed by the comparison image of ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso(φ,T).hom. The single-functor unit isomorphisms in its original definition contribute identity maps.

proof.text: Apply ordinaryScalarUnitSandwich, take its image under the etale/pro-etale comparison functor and precompose the site/scalar comparison. The outer composition and mapIso hom equations identify the left side with the definition of finiteGeneralRingScalarUnitIso.

proof_origin.place: Proof (1)-(2); explicit Lean construction and square pasting

lean.statement:
theorem scalarUnit_formula
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B) (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    (finiteGeneralRingScalarUnitIso φ T).hom =
      (pbcComparisonReduction T φ).hom.app (Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnit A T) ≫
        (Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.comparison B T).map
          (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso φ T).hom
